investigation.variantsFound: Grepped every file under supabase/migrations_archive/legacy/ for 'on public.business_members' policies — confirmed exactly two SELECT-policy variants have ever existed, and no UPDATE/DELETE policy has ever existed on business_members at all (member removal/role changes, where they happen, go through a service-role backend path, e.g. lib/business/team-invites.ts's acceptBusinessInvite, bypassing RLS entirely — unaffected by this repair).
investigation.variant1Recursive: 005_kebu_id_draft_business.sql / APPLY_MIGRATIONS_005_007.sql / APPLY_ALL_PHASE_ONE.sql:613-621 — 'Users select own memberships': `user_id = auth.uid() or exists (select 1 from business_members m2 where m2.business_id = business_members.business_id and m2.user_id = auth.uid() and m2.status = 'active' and m2.role in ('founder','administrator'))` — a policy on business_members directly re-querying business_members from inside itself, the same recursion class as room_members (fixed in K063, 20261016162000) and library_nodes/library_shares (20261016120000). Reproduced against a locally reconstructed fixture: raises 'infinite recursion detected in policy for relation business_members' for any founder/administrator trying to read a teammate's row.
investigation.variant2SelfRowOnly: 020_fix_business_members_rls.sql, explicitly titled 'Fix recursive RLS on business_members that can block membership reads' — dropped the second branch entirely, leaving `user_id = auth.uid()` only. This removes the recursion but also removes the ability for a founder/administrator to ever see a teammate's row — reproduced: returns zero rows, not an error, for exactly the same read.
investigation.liveStateUnknown: This workspace has no hosted Supabase access and cannot determine which variant (if either, verbatim) is currently live. The repair is written to be safe either way, via `drop policy if exists` on the one policy name both variants share.

fix.migration: supabase/migrations/20261016170000_business_members_select_recursion_repair.sql — restores the ORIGINAL intended authorization (a founder/administrator may read every member row of their own business; everyone else sees only their own row) without the recursion, via a new SECURITY DEFINER helper, private.is_active_business_admin(business_id).
fix.deliberateDesignReviewPerInstruction: The user explicitly asked not to copy a privileged helper merely because another module uses one, and to review authority/caller-identity/execution-grants/search-path boundaries. Compared against private.is_room_admin(room_id, user_id) (K063) and chose a DIFFERENT, stricter shape: private.is_active_business_admin takes NO user-id parameter — it always checks auth.uid() internally (mirroring can_access_room's shape instead), so even if it were ever reachable outside the policies that call it, it can only ever answer 'is the calling user an admin of this business' and cannot be used to probe any other user's membership or role. It lives in the `private` schema (not exposed by PostgREST's default schema config — the same boundary every other private.* helper in this codebase already relies on) with execution restricted to authenticated/service_role only.

verifiedScenarios.file: tests/business/business-members-select-policy.local.test.ts — 10 real-SQL PGlite cases against a LOCALLY RECONSTRUCTED fixture matching the archived schema (supabase/migrations_archive/legacy/005_kebu_id_draft_business.sql's exact column/constraint set for businesses/business_members), not the hosted project.
verifiedScenarios.regressionConfirmation: Confirms both archived defects are real before trusting any fix: the recursive variant throws 'infinite recursion' when a founder reads a teammate's row; the self-row-only variant silently returns zero rows for the same read.
verifiedScenarios.repairVerifiedAgainstBothVariants: For each of the two archived variants, with the repair layered on top: a founder sees the full 3-member roster; an administrator (not just the founder) also sees the full roster; a non-admin employee still sees only their own row (the ORIGINAL tighter authorization is preserved, not widened to 'any active member'); a non-member stranger sees nothing.
verifiedScenarios.total: 10 cases, all gated on KEBU_LOCAL_PGLITE_ROOT, all passed.
